How to acces the billing section

To access the billing section, follow these steps:

Input Details:
- Patient File Type: OP, IP, new, or outsider.
- For new patients, use 'F4' to load the registration screen.
- For existing patients, search using document ID, mobile number, or name.

Process Steps:
1. Select the file type of the patient.
2. For new patients, click 'F4' to register.
3. For existing patients, enter the file number to load details.
4. Click on the patient's name to view the profile and last visit details.
5. To verify insurance eligibility, click on 'Elig. Discovery'.
6. Choose consultation or service for billing from the service list.
7. Select the item code or name for laboratory or radiology services and click 'Add'.
8. Allocate the payment category and cash/credit scheme to the patient.
9. Click 'Save' to generate the service bill.
10. Use 'Reprint' to generate a reprint of the bill if needed.

Images:
![Billing Section](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113401.png)

Outcome:
- The billing section will display the patient's details, and you can generate or reprint the service bill as needed.

Estimate And Estimate Approval

To access the Estimate and Estimate Approval process, follow these steps:

Input Details:
- Patient File Number: Enter the patient's file number (e.g., 000223823L).
- Estimate Number: Enter the estimate number (e.g., EST-000000224L).
- From Date: Specify the start date for the estimate bill.
- To Date: Specify the end date for the estimate bill.
- Estimate Status: Select the status (e.g., All, Estimate Approved, Estimate Rejected).

Process Steps:
1. Click on the 'Estimate' button when the patient is ready to make the payment.
2. View the estimated bills and double-click on the estimated bill to make payment.
3. For insurance patients, click on 'Est. Apprvl' to approve the billing items after receiving approval from the insurance company.
4. To generate a printout of the service and deduct bills, check the 'Print Bill' and 'Print Deduct Bill' checkboxes.
5. For consultation card and sticker, check the 'Print card' and 'Print Sticker' checkboxes respectively.
6. Click the 'External' button to select appointments scheduled through the online portal.
7. Click the 'Ref.Bill' button to download referred services from outside centers.
8. View EMR orderings by clicking the 'Emr' button.
9. Add referral letters by clicking the 'Referral' button.
10. Add documents submitted by patients by clicking the 'Scan' button.

Images:
![Estimate and Approval Process](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114007.png)

Outcome:
- The estimate bills will be listed based on the input criteria, and you can proceed with the billing process as needed.

Privilege Card

The Privilege Card utilization form is used to view available privilege cards and their utilization details. You can filter and search based on membership number, document number, policy number, and mobile number. This form can be accessed by clicking the 'Prv.Card' button from the OP service billing screen. You can also view patient attached documents by clicking the 'VScan' button, allocate cash and credit schemes, view patient visit history, and generate service bills. Here is a related image for reference: ![Privilege Card Utilization](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114335.png)

vscan

The VScan form is used to view the scanned documents of the patient. You can access this form by clicking the 'VScan' button from the OP service billing screen. Here are the key details:

Input Details:
- File No: Enter the file number of the patient. For manual entry, just enter digits (except zero) and press the enter key; remaining characters will be filled automatically (e.g., type 223723, and it will change to 000223723L).

Process Steps:
1. Enter the file number to view attached documents.
2. Click on a particular document category to see the documents attached to it.
3. Click on the patient's name to view the patient's profile.
4. Click 'Download Image' to download the document image.
5. Click 'Convert Image to PDF' to convert the image into PDF format.
6. Click 'Card Scan' to scan the submitting card.
7. Click 'Scan' to scan the document.
8. Click 'Print' to print the document.

Images:
![VScan for OP Billing Service](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114308.png)

Outcome:
- The scanned documents of the patient will be displayed, allowing you to manage and utilize them as needed.
